title: Where to Compute and How to Interact: Operator-Readable Adaptation with Gauge-Aware Transport
abstract: arXiv:2609.15620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adaptive meshes enable neural operators for partial differential equations (PDEs) to allocate spatial samples and computation according to local physical structures. Existing approaches, however, mainly address where to compute, with less attention to how information should interact after node relocation. Mesh adaptation changes local sampling scales, neighborhood structures, and geometric contexts, so representations formed at different nodes may not be directly comparable. Direct aggregation can therefore entangle physical variation with discretization-induced representation variation. Because allocation and interaction are jointly optimized through the same output objective, their individual roles are also difficult to distinguish from final errors alone. We introduce operator readability, requiring an adaptive operator to account for and test why computation is allocated to particular locations and how representations interact under

translated_title: 在何处计算与如何交互：基于规范感知传输的算子可读自适应
translated_abstract: 自适应网格使求解偏微分方程（PDE）的神经算子能够根据局部物理结构来分配空间采样和计算资源。然而，现有方法主要解决“在哪里计算”的问题，而对节点重定位后信息“应如何交互”关注较少。网格自适应会改变局部采样尺度、邻域结构和几何上下文，因此在不同节点处形成的表示可能无法直接比较。直接聚合因此会将物理变化与离散化引起的表示变化纠缠在一起。此外，由于分配与交互通过同一输出目标进行联合优化，仅凭最终误差也难以区分二者的各自作用。我们引入了“算子可读性”（operator readability）的概念，要求自适应算子能够解释并检验为什么将计算分配到特定位置，以及表示在不同条件下如何交互（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“算子可读性”概念与规范感知传输机制，解决自适应网格神经算子中计算分配与信息交互耦合不清的问题，避免物理变化与离散化导致的表示差异相互纠缠。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces operator readability with gauge-aware transport for adaptive-mesh neural operators, disentangling where computation is allocated from how representations interact, so that physical variation is not confounded with discretization-induced representational changes.
